name: komdosh-dev-infra-argocd
description: ArgoCD GitOps delivery — Application/ApplicationSet/AppProject authoring and sync/health diagnosis. Ships the argocd-app-author agent (pinned targetRevision, automated sync with prune+selfHeal, sync waves, AppProject scoping, ignoreDifferences, app-of-apps) and the read-only argocd-diagnostician agent (OutOfSync/Degraded/sync-failure/drift root-cause with git-based remediation, never manual kubectl), two internal skills (discover-argocd-apps inventory, probe-app-health read-only argocd/kubectl status probe), two rule documents (argocd-applications, gitops-delivery), and three commands: /argo-app, /argo-diagnose, /argo-audit. Rollback is git revert; the cluster is never mutated out of band. Requires komdosh-dev-infra-core.
